ItemID: NA; Title: New; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This looks compatible with my interest in veteran rock artists, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Live in Hollywood; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little reason to choose this live recording today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Something New The U.S. Album; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar classic rock appeals, but I am more interested in a fresh blues-oriented listen right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After Old Sock and People, Hell & Angels, this relaxed blues-rock tribute is the one I would choose today.
ItemID: NA; Title: This House Is Not For Sale; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for something closer to the rootsy sound of my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Another Country; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It seems worth considering alongside my recent veteran-artist albums, but I would need to hear a sample before choosing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Rattle That Lock; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Guitar-led rock interests me, though I would leave this for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Eagles, The Studio Albums 1972-1979; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The classic rock sound fits, but a whole album collection is more than I want to explore today.
ItemID: NA; Title: All Your Favorite Bands; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its roots-rock direction sounds promising given my recent listening, but I am only choosing one album this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic rock is relevant to me, but I am more drawn to blues and roots-oriented music today.
